rationale: Calculated the reactive power needed to raise each bus voltage to the target of 0.98 pu. For bus_2, the required 22.5 kvar was within the available 25.36 kvar capacity, so the full amount was dispatched, achieving the target voltage. For bus_3, the required 23.33 kvar exceeded the available 13.86 kvar capacity, so the maximum available was dispatched, resulting in a corrected voltage of 0.9686 pu. The total absolute reactive power dispatched is 36.3564 kvar.
